title: Contrastive Projection: Reading Transformer Internals by Differencing Logit Lenses
abstract: arXiv:2609.09902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reading a transformer's internal states in token space is easy to do and hard to trust: a logit lens on a single hidden state is dominated, at intermediate layers, by the generic tokens the model would predict for almost any input. We read the difference instead. Subtracting two closely matched prompts' hidden states and projecting through the unembedding cancels the shared component and surfaces what separates them, an operation equivalent to reading a RepE/ActAdd steering vector through a logit lens. Built into a training-free tracer that reads at every position, sub-layer, and head and averages over designed baselines, it traces a compound- noun MLP->attention chain in Phi-2, confirmed there by activation patching, with the same distinction recovered across three architectures by readout and probe rather than by patching; it reads what retrieval surfaces for real versus fictional entities, and reads metaphor as a set of domain-to-doma

translated_title: 对比投影：通过差分Logit透镜读取Transformer内部状态
translated_abstract: 在词元空间中读取Transformer的内部状态很容易做到，却难以令人信服：在中间层，对单个隐藏状态应用logit透镜的结果主要由模型对几乎任何输入都会预测的通用词元所主导。我们转而读取差异。将两个高度匹配的提示词的隐藏状态相减，并通过反嵌入矩阵投影，可以抵消共享成分、凸显出区分两者的因素——这一操作等价于通过logit透镜读取RepE/ActAdd引导向量。将其构建为一个无需训练的追踪器，可在每个位置、每个子层和每个注意力头上进行读取，并在设计的基线上取平均，它成功追踪出Phi-2中复合名词的MLP→注意力信息链路，并通过激活补丁在该模型中得到验证；在三种架构上，通过读取输出和探针（而非补丁）恢复了相同的区分结果；它能读取检索为真实实体与虚构实体所呈现的差异，并将隐喻解读为一组领域到领域的映射。
tldr: 提出对比投影方法，通过差分两个相近提示词的隐藏状态并经反嵌入投影来抵消共享的通用成分，构建无需训练的追踪器，从而可靠地读取Transformer在每个位置、子层和注意力头上真正区分输入的内部信息流。
en_tdlr: Proposes contrastive projection, which differences hidden states of closely matched prompts and projects through the unembedding to cancel shared generic components, yielding a training-free tracer that reliably reads, at every position, sub-layer, and head of a transformer, what truly distinguishes the inputs.
